title: MCP transport is hand-rolled, not an SDK
evidence: server.go:65 Serve() implements JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio (initialize/initialized/ping/tools/list/tools/call) by hand; go.mod has zero dependencies
suggestion: Acceptable — protocol handshake and tool dispatch are fully implemented and exercised by TestMCPTransport (soccer_test.go:109). Noted for cross-run comparison since most runs use an SDK.

title: Exposes MCP tools only, no resources
evidence: server.go:118 advertises only capabilities.tools; no resources/* methods are handled
suggestion: Spec R1 asks for tools/handlers, which are present; resources are optional. No action needed.

title: Integration test asserts exact real-dataset standings
evidence: soccer_test.go:236 computes 2019 Série A table from the real CSVs and asserts flamengo=90pts/38 played, santos=74, palmeiras=74 — guards the cross-source dedup regression
